doc.description: The fuzz build/run logic now lives in the Makefile (single source of truth), so it can never drift from the real build the way this script used to. make fuzz-afl   -> AFL++ over the full headless pipeline (this script) make fuzz       -> libFuzzer over the HTML parser make fuzz-pv    -> libFuzzer over the display-list builder (page_view) make fuzz-js    -> libFuzzer over the JS sandbox make fuzz-img   -> libFuzzer over the PNG decoder
